question: Which industry do cotton, jute, silk, woollen textiles, sugar and edible oil, etc. belong to ?
solution:
The correct answer is__** agro based industry.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cotton, jute, silk, woollen textiles, sugar and edible oil** are all derived from agricultural products, hence they belong to the** agro-based industry.**
 
• Agro-based industries are those that use agricultural products as their raw materials to **produce finished goods.**
